nodes.title: Review the ComposeFlow subagent workflow
nodes.description: Inspect the implementation and validation behavior, then combine the findings.

acceptance: Show both subagent workflows and their returned findings.
Preserve the parallel relationship between the two subagent calls.

steps: Ask Explore to inspect the model and rendering path.
Ask General to inspect validation and trace handling.
Combine both reports into one result.

criteria: Each subagent has a recorded workflow and result.
Parallel subagent calls share the same parallelGroup.

workflow.action: Check whether nested calls remain visible.

subagents.task: Inspect how nested trace data passes ComposeFlow validation.

workflow.action: Validate a workflow containing subagent data.

actions.description: Summarize the two returned results against the Task contract.
